primary_source_observations: _normalize_database_url maps an empty URL to sqlite+aiosqlite:///./app.db, postgres:// to postgresql+asyncpg://, and plain postgresql:// to postgresql+asyncpg://.

engine_kwargs are decided from the raw settings.DATABASE_URL before normalization. Any raw value that does not start with sqlite, including the empty string, receives pool_size=10 and max_overflow=20 before create_async_engine is called with the normalized URL.
The engine is then constructed from the normalized DATABASE_URL with echo=settings.DEBUG and pool_pre_ping=True.
AsyncSessionLocal is constructed locally from that engine with expire_on_commit=False; get_db yields a session, commits on success, rolls back on exception, and closes in finally.
create_tables uses engine.begin and Base.metadata.create_all, but catches initialization exceptions and only prints the failure instead of re-raising it.
The exact file contains no hard-coded hosted database endpoint and reads no separate credential variable; the opaque runtime settings.DATABASE_URL remains the routing/configuration input.
inference: The scientist_agents receipt correctly identifies the normalization, engine/session construction, and unresolved runtime DATABASE_URL risk, but its pooling summary is too coarse: pool sizing is keyed from the raw URL before normalization, so an empty raw URL that becomes SQLite also receives those kwargs.
